title: Prognostic Factors in Zygapophyseal Osteoarthritis Infiltration: a Prospective Cohort Study
brief_summary: Magnet Resonance Image findings of facet osteoarthritis and patient characteristics are prognostic factors for improving or worsening the clinical outcome after treatment with facet infiltration.
study_population: All patients seen at the spine outpatient clinic of a tertiary hospital with clinical diagnosis of low back pain of facet origin will be eligible to participate in the study
condition: Degenerative Arthropathy of Lumbar Spinal Facet Joint
